about.description: Reel Surprise Charters is a family-owned brand of Orange Beach fishing charters and boutique marina services, located at SanRoc Cay. Founded in 1999 by Randy Boggs and Susan, they operate a 65' Bonner head boat and offer inshore and offshore fishing charters. The marina features 54 premium boat slips, a fully-stocked dock store with fuel, shopping, restaurants, clean restroom facilities, and more. They provide bilingual crew services and have over 20 years of experience on the Gulf Coast.
about.elevator_pitch: Family-owned fishing charters and boutique marina in Orange Beach with spacious vessels, expert local crew, and premium marina services since 1999.
about.vibe: Family-friendly, locally-loved, welcoming to all experience levels, with experienced captains and deckhands who treat guests like family.
about.capacity: Head boat up to 35 passengers | Inshore charters up to 4 passengers | Six-passenger charters up to 6 passengers
about.departure_location: SanRoc Cay Marina, Orange Beach, AL
about.insider_tip: Reel Surprise Marina is the closest to the Gulf, meaning less travel time and more fishing time. They offer a Frequent Fishing Program with discounted rates for repeat customers.

specials.name: Frequent Fishing Program
specials.description: First 8 trips: $100 per trip | 9th trip: $50 | 10th trip: FREE. Includes fishing license, fishing tackle, and bait. Targeted species: Vermillion Snapper and Lane Snapper.

specials.name: Short Term Slip Rentals
